units.source_text: 叶子的屋前也有这种“哈蒂”。

en.t: There was this same kind of hatte in front of Yoko's house too.

units.source_text: 她的家修建在公路旁稍稍洼下去的大田里，高高的“哈蒂”拴在院子左边沿着邻居的白墙种着的一排柿子树上。

en.t: Her house stood in a large field that dipped slightly beside the road, and a tall hatte was tied to a row of persimmon trees along the neighbor's white wall on the left side of the yard.

units.source_text: 在大田和院子接壤的地方，即柿子树上的“哈蒂”成直角处，也拴有“哈蒂”，

en.t: At the place where the field met the yard, that is, where it formed a right angle with the hatte on the persimmon trees, another hatte had also been tied up,

units.source_text: 在它的一头开了一个入口，可以从这些稻穗底下钻进去。

en.t: and at one end an entrance had been opened, so one could duck in beneath those ears of rice.

units.source_text: 这活像是用稻草而不是用草席盖起来的草棚子。

en.t: It looked exactly like a little grass hut roofed with rice straw rather than straw matting.

units.source_text: 在这块大田里，枯萎了的西番莲和蔷薇的跟前，青芋在伸展着繁茂的叶子。

en.t: In that large field, in front of withered dahlias and roses, green taro plants were spreading their lush leaves.

units.source_text: 养着红鲤的荷池在“哈蒂”那头，已经看不见了。

en.t: The lotus pond with the red carp was beyond the hatte and could no longer be seen.
